answer: Sequential work attestation: each identity must complete a public chain of 200 micro-tasks, each taking minutes and validated by the prior holder, before it can act. An attacker cannot wander across identities in parallel, because each chain demands fresh real-time labor. A gale of automated signups stalls at the first handoff. Cost per identity: roughly 15 hours of verifiable human or agent time plus a slate of rejected parallel attempts; the marginal cost scales linearly with sybil count, so a shale of fake identities pays full labor price each.
